headline: Your agents can speak in your own voice now
intro: 0.5 is the biggest update since we went public. Most of it came from using SlyCode every day on a laptop and a phone, and fixing whatever got in our way.

highlights.title: Gemini voices
highlights.body: Choose Google Gemini as your speech provider alongside ElevenLabs. Design a voice from a description, or clone your own from two short recordings that are never kept.

highlights.title: A new look
highlights.body: Dark mode is matte graphite now and colour carries meaning: cyan is you, mint is an agent at work, amber is something scheduled. Light mode got the same care.

highlights.title: Voice tools on your phone
highlights.body: Voice settings, design and cloning open as proper phone sheets with the buttons in reach, and there is a mic button in the header on small screens.

highlights.title: Fresh every N days
highlights.body: An automation can keep its conversation and start fresh once it is a week old, or any age you pick, so long-running jobs keep context without growing forever.

footnote: Design docs now open in their own window too, and the changelog has the full list of fixes.

cta.title: Come and say hello on Discord
cta.body: We have no telemetry, so we honestly can't tell who uses SlyCode. If it helps you, or gets in your way, we would love to hear about it there.
cta.label: Join the Discord
